scope: Development-only throughput diagnostic; not correctness, failure detection or routing effectiveness

selection.method: SHA-256 identity ranking within benchmark x static source file, per_stratum=1, seed namespace 1729

limitations: Sequential client timings include prompt building, parsing and saving overhead.
Batch wall time is not GPU kernel-active time or total allocated runtime.
Setup, downloads, warm-up and idle GPU allocation are recorded separately in Colab.
Interrupted attempts have unknown elapsed time and possibly unknown billed tokens.
Coverage-stratified subset is not population-weighted; no accuracy/routing claim.

runtime_metadata.note: Observed one-GPU wall window, not kernel-active time or full billed allocation. Runtime remains allocated until disconnected.

checked: 69 unique file-qualified keys; all resolve to primary development groups
